name: Median Graphs Are Strictly Dismantlable Ample
statement: Every finite median graph is dismantlable ample, and the inclusion is strict.
proof: Median classes have ordering width zero, hence are dismantlable ample. The vertex-deleted three-cube is ample of VC dimension two and therefore dismantlable ample, but its three maximal vertices have missing coordinatewise majority and it is not median.
